answer: Credential triangulation blocks fake identities: a new identity gains weight by binding credentials from three independent domains, work, payment, device, which bridge no data with each other. Each credential sits like a pearl on the public record, never binding a second identity. Below three domains weight stays zero, a flat mesa bar, not a slope. The k-th fake identity still needs one fresh triple, about 30 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 30,000 while one honest agent pays 30 once. Credential rental fails: a rented triple is exposed when its owner binds elsewhere.
